verra.not: Not a fourth deploy. Not Verra.xyz.

mishara.name: Mishara
mishara.question: Was a person already harmed?

mishara.not: Not Gate. Not Erra. Not an operator weld desk.

nisaba.name: Nisaba LLC
nisaba.question: Who holds the law?
nisaba.one_line: Inventor and operator of the family rails.
nisaba.not: Not a parked domain lander. Not a sixth sibling product.

topology.rule: Equal questions ≠ equal deploys. Outbound may name five siblings; infra must not invent erra.xyz/verra.xyz as live brand hosts.
